business_context.industry_terms: 自行车零售与制造、B2B销售、库存管理、供应链、产品生命周期、销售区域、员工绩效、采购管理、工单生产
business_context.business_rules: AdventureWorks是一家自行车及配件制造商，核心产品类别包括Bikes(自行车)、Components(零配件)、Clothing(服装)、Accessories(配件)。销售订单通过salesorderheader和salesorderdetail追踪，产品层级为productcategory→productsubcategory→product
business_context.data_characteristics: 产品数据包含product、productcategory、productsubcategory三层结构；销售数据通过salesorderheader(订单头)和salesorderdetail(订单明细)关联；供应商通过vendor表管理，采购通过purchaseorderheader追踪；员工信息在employee表，部门历史在employeedepartmenthistory
business_context.analysis_focus: 产品销售分析、客户价值分析、供应商采购分析、库存管理、区域销售业绩、员工绩效、生产工单完成率

example_queries.query: 查询各产品类别的平均成本对比
example_queries.sql_pattern: SELECT pc.Name AS CategoryName, AVG(p.StandardCost) AS AvgCost FROM productcategory pc JOIN productsubcategory ps ON pc.ProductCategoryID = ps.ProductCategoryID JOIN product p ON ps.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryID, pc.Name ORDER BY AvgCost DESC
example_queries.description: 产品类别成本分析（与aw031型号统计不同，关注成本维度）

example_queries.query: 查询采购量最多的10个产品
example_queries.sql_pattern: SELECT p.Name AS ProductName, SUM(pod.OrderQty) AS TotalQty FROM product p JOIN purchaseorderdetail pod ON p.ProductID = pod.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Name ORDER BY TotalQty DESC LIMIT 10
example_queries.description: 采购量使用purchaseorderdetail.OrderQty字段求和（与销售额类似的聚合模式）

example_queries.query: 查询每个销售人员的客户数量
example_queries.sql_pattern: SELECT sp.BusinessEntityID, COUNT(DISTINCT soh.CustomerID) AS CustomerCount FROM salesperson sp JOIN salesorderheader soh ON sp.BusinessEntityID = soh.SalesPersonID GROUP BY sp.BusinessEntityID ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC
example_queries.description: 销售人员通过SalesPersonID与订单关联（与区域订单类似的JOIN模式）

example_queries.query: 查询每个产品有多少个供应商
example_queries.sql_pattern: SELECT p.Name AS ProductName, COUNT(pv.BusinessEntityID) AS VendorCount FROM product p JOIN productvendor pv ON p.ProductID = pv.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Name ORDER BY VendorCount DESC
example_queries.description: 产品供应商关系通过productvendor表关联（与供应商采购类似的GROUP BY模式）

example_queries.query: 查询购买过服装(Clothing)类产品的区域数量
example_queries.sql_pattern: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT soh.TerritoryID) AS TerritoryCount FROM salesorderheader soh JOIN salesorderdetail sod ON soh.SalesOrderID = sod.SalesOrderID JOIN product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN productsubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN productcategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID WHERE pc.Name = 'Clothing'
example_queries.description: 多表关联过滤类别后统计区域（与Bikes客户统计类似的5表JOIN模式）

example_queries.query: 查询每个产品的总采购成本
example_queries.sql_pattern: SELECT p.Name AS ProductName, SUM(pod.LineTotal) AS TotalCost FROM product p JOIN purchaseorderdetail pod ON p.ProductID = pod.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Name ORDER BY TotalCost DESC LIMIT 10
example_queries.description: 采购成本使用purchaseorderdetail.LineTotal（与客户订单金额类似的SUM模式）

example_queries.query: 查询没有采购记录的供应商
example_queries.sql_pattern: SELECT v.Name FROM vendor v LEFT JOIN purchaseorderheader poh ON v.BusinessEntityID = poh.VendorID WHERE poh.VendorID IS NULL
example_queries.description: 使用LEFT JOIN配合IS NULL检查无关联记录（与无销售产品类似的LEFT JOIN模式）

example_queries.query: 查询每季度的采购趋势
example_queries.sql_pattern: SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS Year, QUARTER(OrderDate) AS Quarter, SUM(TotalDue) AS QuarterlyPurchase, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM purchaseorderheader GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate), QUARTER(OrderDate) ORDER BY Year, Quarter
example_queries.description: 时间分析使用YEAR()和QUARTER()函数（与月度销售趋势类似的时间序列模式）

example_queries.query: 计算每个销售区域的订单占比
example_queries.sql_pattern: WITH TerritorySales AS (SELECT t.Name AS Territory, COUNT(soh.SalesOrderID) AS OrderCount FROM salesterritory t JOIN salesorderheader soh ON t.TerritoryID = soh.TerritoryID GROUP BY t.TerritoryID, t.Name), TotalOrders AS (SELECT SUM(OrderCount) AS Total FROM TerritorySales) SELECT ts.Territory, ts.OrderCount, ts.OrderCount / tos.Total * 100 AS Percentage FROM TerritorySales ts, TotalOrders tos ORDER BY Percentage DESC
example_queries.description: 使用CTE计算占比（与类别销售占比类似的CTE模式但针对区域订单）

example_queries.query: 查询库存周转率高的库位
example_queries.sql_pattern: SELECT l.Name AS LocationName, SUM(pi.Quantity) AS TotalStock, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.ProductID) AS ProductVariety FROM location l JOIN productinventory pi ON l.LocationID = pi.LocationID GROUP BY l.LocationID, l.Name ORDER BY ProductVariety DESC
example_queries.description: 库位库存统计通过location与productinventory关联（与库存预警类似的库存表JOIN模式）

query_patterns.pattern: product p JOIN productsubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN productcategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
query_patterns.explanation: AdventureWorks产品层级: productcategory → productsubcategory → product

query_patterns.pattern: salesorderheader o JOIN salesorderdetail od ON o.SalesOrderID = od.SalesOrderID
query_patterns.explanation: 订单头包含TotalDue总金额，订单明细包含LineTotal单行金额

query_patterns.pattern: vendor v JOIN purchaseorderheader po ON v.BusinessEntityID = po.VendorID
query_patterns.explanation: 供应商主键是BusinessEntityID，通过它关联采购订单的VendorID

query_patterns.pattern: salesterritory t JOIN salesorderheader o ON t.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID
employee e JOIN employeedepartmenthistory edh ON e.EmployeeID = edh.EmployeeID WHERE edh.EndDate IS NULL
query_patterns.explanation: 使用EndDate IS NULL获取当前在职部门

query_patterns.pattern: product p JOIN productinventory pi ON p.ProductID = pi.ProductID
shift s JOIN employeedepartmenthistory edh ON s.ShiftID = edh.ShiftID JOIN employee e ON edh.BusinessEntityID = e.BusinessEntityID WHERE edh.EndDate IS NULL
query_patterns.explanation: 员工班次通过employeedepartmenthistory.ShiftID关联，使用EndDate IS NULL获取当前在职员工

key_concepts.Bikes: 自行车类产品，是AdventureWorks的核心产品线，分为Mountain Bikes、Road Bikes、Touring Bikes
key_concepts.Components: 自行车零配件，包括车架(Frames)、车轮(Wheels)、刹车(Brakes)等
key_concepts.LineTotal: salesorderdetail中的单行销售金额，已包含折扣计算
key_concepts.TotalDue: salesorderheader中的订单总金额，包含税费和运费
key_concepts.ProductSubcategoryID: 产品关联类别的关键字段，需通过productsubcategory中间表
